name: Teen Titans New Member
source: After Robin and Cyborg's departure to the Justice League, the Teen Titans are in need of new members, so Superman decides to recommend you, a kryptonian with a tragic and mysterious past. Get acquainted with your new friends in Raven, Starfire, and Beastgirl, fight and punish your newfound fans and villains in unorthodox ways, and try not to let the dark echoes of your past get to you.
translation: 罗宾和钢骨离开正义联盟后，少年泰坦需要新成员，因此超人决定推荐你，一个有着悲惨而神秘的过去的氪星人。结识《乌鸦》、《星火》和《野兽女孩》中的新朋友，以非正统的方式对抗和惩罚新认识的粉丝和恶棍，并尽量不要让过去的黑暗回声影响到你。
